Tier2 plain conversion with accessible names disabled

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		InlineDataMedia: ptr(htmd.InlineDataMediaAltTextOnly),
		OutputFormat:    ptr(htmd.OutputFormatPlain),
		TierStrategy:    ptr(htmd.TierStrategy(`Tier2`)),
	}
	result, err := htmd.ConvertWithAccessibleNames(`<p><svg aria-label="Name"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>`, false, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
